subject: Request: AWS Private Offer — accelerated invoice schedule & rev-share adjustment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novaretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: payment cadence + rev-share for AWS private offer

Tom / team — thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Attached is the draft private-offer paperwork and our proposed commercial split. Two asks from Nova that require internal clearance on our side before I send a clean PO-ready package: 

1) Accelerated invoicing: Nova wants 60% invoiced at signature (invoice due Net-45), remainder invoiced at 12 months. They prefer a one-time upfront invoice rather than monthly usage billing.
2) Rev-share adjustment: because of the higher upfront commitment they requested a temporary rev-share floor reduction to 15% (standard Marketplace floor is 20%) for the first 12 months.

They also asked for a 2% early-payment discount if the upfront invoice is paid within 10 days. Finance and deal desk approval required because this deviates from our marketplace and finance defaults. Can we get an expedited exec review? We are targeting signature by next Wednesday.

Attachments: proposal-quote-99321.xlsx, NovaRetail_MA-EO-terms_v3.pdf

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: payment cadence + rev-share for AWS private offer

Jordan — looping Deal Desk. Quick notes: 
- Accelerated invoicing is operationally possible for Private Offers but marketplace invoicing/revenue split flows differently when customer requests upfront invoice outside standard AWS flow. Need finance confirmation on rev-rec and whether AWS will pass through the upfront invoice amount to us in the same month.
- Rev-share floor reduce to 15% for 12 months is a material commercial concession; requires Sales Ops + Revenue approval.

Marissa — can legal confirm there are no downstream compliance issues with the modified invoicing/discount (especially around refunds/clawback if credits apply)? Evelyn — please advise on revenue recognition/booking impact and whether early-pay discount is ok from an accounting standpoint.

Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: payment cadence + rev-share for AWS private offer

Karthik / Jordan — read the attachments. Two quick legal flags: 
1) If we reduce the rev-share floor we should add a 12-month performance milestone (minimum ARR or usage tiers) that reverts to standard terms if threshold not met. This protects us from overly deep discounts with limited consumption.
2) Upfront invoice + early-pay discount: we need explicit language about refund/cancellation handling and a clawback if the customer churns within 90 days. Also confirm who signs the commercial addendum (Redwood vs AWS marketplace listing owner).

I'll draft the addendum language if deal desk wants the clause text.

Marissa

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-08T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: payment cadence + rev-share for AWS private offer

Team — finance POV: 
- Accelerated invoice (60% upfront, Net-45) is acceptable operationally but will accelerate cash and defer usage-based revenue. We need to book the upfront as deferred revenue and recognize against usage; confirm expected annualized usage to size potential revenue volatility.
- Rev-share to 15% for 12 months reduces gross margin materially vs standard. I need CFO approval for any change > 3% off standard floor. Provide modeled P&L (12-month) showing impact (I attached a quick sensitivity sketch).
- Early-pay 2% is minor but must be included in invoice templates to ensure accounts payable can take discount; confirm whether AWS will accept the discount within their billing flow.

If Sales can provide: 1) 12-month usage forecast, 2) confirmation AWS invoicing will not complicate pass-through accounting, I can triage with Finance leadership for sign-off.

Evelyn

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T11:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: payment cadence + rev-share for AWS private offer

Folks — I reviewed Finance notes and modeled the worst-case consumption (40% of forecast). Conditional approval from me for a 15% rev-share floor for 12 months under these conditions: 
- Add a 12-month minimum usage milestone; if not met, rev-share reverts to 20% and customer owes a clawback on discounts within 90 days.
- Legal to add a cancellation/clawback clause and explicit signatory for the addendum.
- Sales to secure a DocuSign PO within 5 business days of our sign-off and confirm AWS marketplace enablement won't delay billing > 10 business days.

If those three items are satisfied, Evelyn you can route the change to CFO for final ok; I can greenlight escalation to execs if needed.

Lauren

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novaretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-09T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: payment cadence + rev-share for AWS private offer

Tom — appreciate your patience. Internal teams have provisionally approved the commercial path with three conditions (see below). If you agree we will issue an updated addendum and DocuSign link today: 

1) 60% upfront invoice at signature (Net-45); remaining invoiced at 12 months. Upfront invoice will include 2% early-pay discount if paid within 10 days.
2) Rev-share floor set to 15% for the first 12 months, subject to a 12-month minimum usage milestone (details will be in addendum). If milestone not met, rev-share reverts to 20% and discounts/clawbacks will apply (90-day window).
3) Addendum to specify cancellation/refund/clawback language and identify Redwood as signatory for the commercial addendum to the AWS private offer.

If that works, please confirm and I'll send the updated DocuSign and the AWS private offer enablement checklist. Goal: sign by Tue 2026-06-15.

Best — Jordan
